title: odontochilus marivelensis
intro: Odontochilus marivelensis, commonly known as the Mariveles orchid, is a species of orchid native to the Philippines. It is a type of flowering plant that is used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Odontochilus marivelensis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of analgesia, anti-inflammation, and antioxidant properties.
